plan.notes: Official term-by-term sequence transcribed 2026-09-30 from Kingsborough's 2025-2026 Degree Map for A.S. Computer Science, MAT 1500 (Calculus I) placement variant (Required Credits: 60; semesters 15/16/17/12). Parsed positionally from the official PDF (pypdf layout mode), not from scrambled text extraction. Each semester is split into Session A and Session B on the map; the session is recorded per course. Grade requirements printed on the map: minimum C+ in MAT 1500 (to advance to MAT 1600), minimum C+ in CS 1200 (prerequisite for CS 13A0 and CS 1400), minimum C+ in CS 13A0, minimum C in MAT 1600. Curriculum-committee prerequisites: CS 13A0 requires CS 1200 (C+ or higher); CS 1400 requires CS 1200 (C+ or higher); CS 3500 requires CS 1200 (C or higher) and MAT 1500 (C+ or higher); CS 3700 requires CS 13A0 (C or higher). Map footnotes: (1) course usually offered every semester; (2) usually offered Fall and Spring; (3) usually offered every Fall (occasionally Spring). Statistics requirement is satisfied by either MAT/BIO 9100 Biostatistics or MAT/BA 2200 Business Statistics (4 credits each in 2025-2026). Students also select one Writing Intensive and one Civic Engagement course from within the plan (some courses satisfy both). Cross-checked against the 2026-2027 MAT 1500 degree map (same course set and 15/16/17/12 totals). HEGIS 5103.00, Program Code 01040, Department of Mathematics and Computer Science.
